description: This file defines the EndpointParameterMiddleware class used within the AWS SDK for PHP to update the host in HTTP requests based on modeled endpoint traits, including methods for wrapping, construction, invocation, and hostname validation.

classes.name: EndpointParameterMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for updating the request host based on endpoint parameters, used within AWS PHP SDK.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a closure that wraps a handler with the middleware, associating it with a specific Service instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the middleware, accepting a next handler callable and a Service object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware logic to modify the request URI's host based on command parameters and endpoint traits.
